thread:
nina: quick civic matter: the office paperclip (the one glued to the monitor stand) has requested formal recognition. i'm proposing we form the Royal Paperclip Consulate. :paperclip:
omar: i second. long live the clip. what powers does the consulate have?
lucy: powers: 1) bless new staplers 2) adjudicate snack disputes 3) approve sticky-note art.
ben: can we draft a tiny constitution? article one: the paperclip gets a tiny felt cloak.
supply-bot: FYI — felt cloaks must be logged as Decorative Supplies per policy. please file request in the Supplies sheet.
marshall: i'm volunteering to be the ceremonial glue applier. steady hands guaranteed.
nina: i made a mock seal (very professional): https://imgur.com/placeholder (image of a paperclip with a crown)
omar: vote on titles: :one: "Keeper of Clips" :two: "First Clerk of the Clip"
lucy: :one: Keeper of Clips. majestic and succinct.
ben: :one:
marshall: :two: (secretly wants the drama)
supply-bot: Reminder: all titles are symbolic and do not change payroll or security access.
nina: inaugural rites scheduled at 11:11 by the snack drawer. bring a paper item to oath on (receipt, sticky note, unused napkin).
omar: i will bring a receipt from the sandwich altar.
lucy: i'll bring a napkin with an inspirational doodle.
ben: can we make a tiny laminated membership card? i can laminate two.
marshall: agreed. also, new rule: any attempt to steal the paperclip will result in mandatory kitchen duty and singing of the office anthem.
nina: canonical anthem line proposal: "Oh clip of metal, hold our memos true" (open to edits) :notes:
supply-bot: Please avoid adhesives on monitors. also, return the paperclip to its throne after ceremonies.
ben: noted. throne = monitor stand. keep it sacred.
lucy: i'm starting a tiny photo album of past consulate meetings. will post in #random-pics after noon.
omar: may the clip endure. long live the Royal Paperclip Consulate. :crown:
